Name: Snowballs
Author: Typhe681
Description:
Ever wanted to throw snowballs at NPCs? This mod adds snowballs that you can dig up with your hoe in winter, load them into your slingshot, and shoot them just like any other ammo.

[size=5][b]Features[/b][/size]
• Snowballs don't decrease NPC friendship, unlike rocks (those are reserved for Haley <3), but can actually [b]increase [/b]friendship if you are good enough friends with them!
• By default, NPCs like you throwing snowballs at them if you are at 3 hearts or more, and it occasionally increases friendship by 10 points (one heart is 250 points).
• You can shoot your pets >:)
• Shooting snowballs at monsters will stun them for 3 seconds (by default).
• Different NPCs react differently when gifted a snowball
• Snowballs can be dug up outdoors during winter, or in the snowy mine levels year-round, but not on ginger island

[size=5][b]Config
[/b][/size]• HeartLimit refers to the amount of hearts needed for an NPC to like being hit with snowballs, and therefore trigger the occasional friendship increase (default is 3 hearts)
• FriendshipBonus is the amount of friendship points to add when the friendship increase occurs (default is 10, one full heart is 250)
• StunTime is the amount of time, in seconds, a monster will be stunned for when hit by a snowball (default is 3 seconds)

[size=5][b]Known Issues
[/b][/size][size=2]• There is a slight desync when snowball projectiles are removed in multiplayer

[/size][size=5][b]Installation
[/b][/size][size=2]• [url=https://smapi.io/]Install the latest version of SMAPI[/url].
• Download [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1720]Json Assets[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/28489]SlingShotFramework[/url]
• Download this mod and place the unzipped folder into [code]StardewValley/Mods
[/code]• Run the game through SMAPI
[/size][size=2]
[/size][size=5][b]See Also[/b][/size][size=2]
• [url=https://github.com/Typhe681/StardewMods/tree/main/Snowballs]Source Code[/url]
• This mod contains some AI generated code
• Farm animals cannot be hit with snowballs, this is vanilla projectile behavior[/size]
